nodes.en: Default: frozen benchmark, runtime and best reference
nodes.zh: 默认路线：固定评测、运行配置与最佳参考版本

nodes.en: One hypothesis and candidate from the reference; protect its snapshot
nodes.zh: 从参考版本提出单个假设与候选；先保护快照
评测完整用例与重复次数矩阵

nodes.en: Strictly higher: retain and append accepted score; otherwise restore
nodes.zh: 严格涨分才保留并登记接纳成绩；否则恢复

nodes.en: OPRO: fixed model and rest of harness; one instruction slot
nodes.zh: OPRO：固定模型及其余框架；只搜索一个指令槽

nodes.en: History of every valid measurement, losing candidates included
nodes.zh: 所有有效测量历史，包含落选候选

nodes.en: Independent proposals share one history snapshot per step
nodes.zh: 每轮独立提案共享同一历史快照

nodes.en: Snapshot and measure each surviving instruction sequentially
nodes.zh: 对保留的指令逐一快照并完成测量

nodes.en: After search: restore highest training-score snapshot; earliest wins ties
nodes.zh: 搜索结束：恢复训练最高分快照；同分保留最早版本

nodes.en: Optional separate test: baseline and winner; never used for selection
nodes.zh: 可选独立测试：基线与胜出版本；不参与选优

edges.zh: 下一轮从保留的参考版本出发

edges.en: append every valid score, not only improvements
edges.zh: 登记全部有效分数，不限涨分候选
